# Test fixtures

Gzipped, unmodified extracts of the public **StatsBomb Open Data** repository
(https://github.com/statsbomb/open-data), used under the StatsBomb Open Data
user agreement. Data provided by StatsBomb / Hudl.

| match | why it is here |
|---|---|
| 3930166 Portugal 2-1 Czech Republic | normal 90-minute match, includes a 150-frame 360 sample |
| 3941017 England 1-1 Switzerland (5-3 pens) | extra time + penalty shoot-out; exercises the out-of-order lineup stint bug and period 5 handling; 360 file deliberately absent (tests optional 404) |
